aboutText: Shallard Electrical has been providing premium electrical solutions for over 20 years in Altona and surrounding suburbs. We pride ourselves on genuine service and advice, ensuring safe, reliable, and high-quality workmanship for every job. Whether it's domestic, commercial, or industrial, we are committed to our local community's electrical needs.
servicesText: Shallard Electrical offers a full suite of electrical services tailored to Altona's needs. From domestic installations to industrial maintenance, our skilled team handles it all with precision and care. We ensure every project meets the highest standards of safety and efficiency.
